jobs.title: NOC Engineer (CCNP Certified)
jobs.description:
About Penbrothers

Penbrothers is an HR & remote talent management partner and one of the fastest-growing companies in the Philippines. We provide talented Filipinos with global opportunities in high-growth startups and dynamic companies, from the comfort of their own homes.

**About the Client**

The client is a rapidly growing UK-based technology consultancy focused on network architecture, digital infrastructure, and cloud transformation. With deep expertise in designing and delivering robust, secure, and scalable network solutions, they partner with some of the world’s leading organizations in sectors such as finance, media, and enterprise technology.

**About the Role**

The successful candidate will be monitoring, supporting and implementing changes for our Managed Service customer in the broadcast media. The candidate will be based remotely and will cover UK Days shifts Monday to Friday.

**Work Set-up:** **100% Work from home**

**Work Schedule:** The normal working hours shall be **Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM UK time** **(4:00 PM to 1:00 AM Philippine time)** .

Note: The Employee may occasionally be required to participate in an on-call rota to support out-of-hours changes or operational requirements, as needed. Any adjustments to working hours will be limited to situations where such support is necessary

What You’ll Do (Duties and Responsibilities)

* Working in our Network Operations Centre as a Network Support Engineer.
* Diagnose and solve problems and incidents with limited supervision and within SLAs.
* Monitor ticket queues, multitask, and prioritise work by shifting focus as and when required.
* Troubleshoot system and network problems, ID root cause and escalate when appropriately.
* Implement network changes and service improvements on customer’s equipment as required.
* Work closely with the NOC team to resolve complex problems.
* Administer and maintain customer infrastructure via change control.
* Perform RMAs, software upgrades and patch management, for several vendors.
* Create technical documents, diagrams, and SOPs whilst maintaining the company's knowledge base.
* Administer and maintain end user accounts, permissions, access rights and inventory.
* Support our Services delivery function by generating appropriate reporting.
* Working with other areas of the business to support the deployment of new products or tools.
* Mentoring Junior members of staff

**What You Bring (Skills, Qualifications or Experience)**

* **Certification:** MUST be **CCNP certified** with an ACTIVE certification status.
* Experience of working with and troubleshooting **BGP**
* Hands on experience, **Cisco** & **Palo Alto**
* An excellent communicator both verbally and written
* Minimum 12 months experience within a **2nd line role support role** .
* Understanding of **ITIL best practices** . (ITIL Foundations certification desirable).
* Customer-centric with good communication skills, both written and verbal.
* General Support and Operations background.
* Hands-on experience with **Switches, Routers, Firewalls and Wifi**
* Knowledge and experience of ticketing/incident management systems (e.g ServiceNow, Zendesk, HaloITSM)
* Previous experience in a similar role at an IT Solutions Provider/MSP.
* Demonstrate working under pressure and own initiative
* Flexibility to work in any shift pattern covering nights, weekends (BH) including 24 x 7 is essential
* Hands on experiencing of upgrading Firmware of Switches, Firewalls and Wireless access points

Nice to Have

* Zscaler
* Juniper Mist
* Multicast
* SDWAN
* Broadcast Media

**Our Hiring Process & AI Disclaimer:** We use AI tools to streamline our application process—including an initial conversation with an AI Interviewer. All hiring decisions are made entirely by humans: our Talent Acquisition team guides your full candidate journey and makes all evaluation decisions.

You are welcome to use AI for CV refinement and research, but real-time AI assistance during interviews or skill assessments is strictly prohibited to ensure an authentic evaluation.

Read our full **AI Disclaimer** to learn more

**What You’ll Get**

At Penbrothers, we are obsessed with creating positive employee experiences. Here you’ll find an environment that nurtures learning and provides opportunities for growth. You’ll have the opportunity to make an impact on fast-growing startups and dynamic companies.

* Meaningful work & Growth: We take every opportunity to stretch ourselves and deliver an excellent client experience.
* Employee as our biggest asset: We are genuinely invested in our people’s career and welfare.
* Global reach & local impact: Get to work with high-growth startups and dynamic companies from the comfort of your own home.
* Powering global startups: We’ve created 1,400 Filipino jobs that empower global start-ups to focus on growth.

jobs.title: Cloud DevOps Engineer (Work from Home with HMO)
jobs.description:
**Position Overview:**

As a Cloud DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the infrastructure and operational workflows that enable the efficient deployment and management of applications and services in cloud environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the reliability, scalability, and security of cloud-based systems, while leveraging automation and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines. Your expertise in cloud platforms, infrastructure-as-code (IaC), and DevOps principles will be critical in driving efficient and effective cloud operations.

**Responsibilities:**

Cloud Infrastructure Design and Deployment:

* Design, implement, and maintain scalable and reliable cloud-based infrastructure architectures (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) using infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools.
* Configure and optimize cloud services such as virtual machines, containers, load balancers, and auto-scaling groups to meet application requirements.
* Collaborate with development teams to establish deployment pipelines and enable continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices.

Automation and Configuration Management:

* Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools to streamline deployment, provisioning, and monitoring processes.
* Utilize configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, Puppet, Chef) to ensure consistency and manage infrastructure configuration changes.
* Implement infrastructure monitoring and logging solutions to enable proactive identification and resolution of operational issues.

System and Application Monitoring:

* Set up and maintain monitoring systems to track infrastructure and application performance metrics, ensuring high availability and reliability.
* Respond to system alerts and troubleshoot performance bottlenecks, working closely with relevant teams to resolve issues promptly.
* Implement incident response processes and participate in on-call rotations to provide timely support and minimize service disruptions.

Security and Compliance:

* Implement and enforce security best practices, including access control, data encryption, and vulnerability management, in accordance with industry standards and regulations.

Collaboration and Documentation:

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including developers, system administrators, and network engineers, to optimize cloud infrastructure and application performance.
* Document infrastructure configurations, deployment processes, and troubleshooting guides to ensure knowledge sharing and maintain a comprehensive repository of operational procedures.
* Stay up to date with emerging cloud technologies, industry trends, and best practices, and evaluate their potential impact on the organization's infrastructure and operations.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field or 4+ years of professional experience
* 3+ years of hands-on development experience in an object-oriented programming language or similar.
* Strong experience with cloud platforms such as AWS **(must have)**, Azure, or Google Cloud, including infrastructure provisioning, networking, and security.
* Hands-on experience with containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration frameworks like Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with scripting and programming languages (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell) for automation and tool development.
* Understanding of DevOps principles and experience implementing GitLab CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in cloud-based environments.
* Knowledge of security best practices and experience implementing security controls in cloud infrastructure.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Knowledge of configuration management tools like Ansible, Puppet, or Chef is a plus.
* Relevant certifications, such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer or Azure DevOps Engineer, are a plus.

Pay: Php40,000.00 - Php50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Company events
* Health insurance
* Pay raise
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Mandaluyong

jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description:
The Network Engineer is responsible for the design, configuration, management, and optimization of the organization’s global network infrastructure, with a primary focus on Cloudflare WARP / Zero Trust, VPN solutions, and secure connectivity for a large remote workforce.

This role ensures reliable, high-performance, and compliant network operations across thousands of distributed users and multiple client environments.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in enterprise networking, network security, and Zero Trust architecture, with experience supporting regulated environments such as HIPAA. While primarily remote, the engineer may occasionally provide coordination or troubleshooting support related to a small third-party-managed secured facility.

**Key ResponsibilitiesCloudflare Zero Trust & Platform Ownership**

* Own and manage **Cloudflare Zero Trust**, including WARP, Gateway, tunnels, posture checks, routing, and access/security policies.
* Architect and automate deployments using **Infrastructure-as-Code tools (e.g., Terraform)** for version control and safe rollbacks.
* Build and optimize **log pipelines, dashboards, alerting, and observability frameworks**.
* Implement **canary rollout strategies** to safely deploy changes at scale.

**Network Architecture & Operations**

* Design and maintain **secure and scalable network infrastructure** across cloud, remote, and hybrid environments.
* Manage **VPNs, routing, VLANs, firewall rules, and identity-based access policies**.
* Monitor **network performance, latency, reliability, and traffic behavior** across global endpoints.
* Participate in **on-call or escalation rotations** for critical network incidents.

**Security & Compliance**

* Enforce **network security controls aligned with regulatory standards**.
* Conduct configuration reviews and maintain **audit readiness and compliance reporting**.
* Support **incident response and root-cause analysis** for security or availability events.

**Access & Identity Integration**

* Integrate network infrastructure with **identity providers (e.g., Entra ID / Azure AD)**.
* Maintain **MFA policies, device posture rules, identity-based routing, and traffic controls**.

**Monitoring & Optimization**

* Deploy monitoring tools for **traffic analytics, threat detection, and capacity forecasting**.
* Troubleshoot **performance degradation, tunneling issues, and Zero Trust access failures**.

**Governance & Documentation**

* Manage **change control processes** for network updates and risk assessments.
* Maintain documentation for **network architecture, configurations, SOPs, and operational changes**.
* Provide regular reporting on **network health, availability, performance, and compliance**.

**Collaboration & Support**

* Work closely with **Infrastructure, Security, Systems, and Client teams** to ensure secure connectivity.
* Act as a **Tier 3 escalation point** for complex network issues.
* Coordinate with **third-party vendors managing secured physical facilities**.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (preferred).
* **3–5 years of experience** in Network Engineering, Network Security, or Zero Trust roles.
* Relevant certifications such as **Network+, CCNA/CCNP, Fortinet NSE, or Cloudflare certifications** are preferred.
* Experience managing **Cloudflare Zero Trust deployments at scale** is highly desirable.

**Key Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience with **Zero Trust networking and secure web gateway solutions**.
* Experience using **Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform preferred)**.
* Solid knowledge of **TCP/IP, DNS, routing, VLANs, firewalls, and distributed troubleshooting**.
* Experience integrating with **identity providers (e.g., Entra ID, Okta)**.
* Familiarity with **automation/scripting (PowerShell, Python, Bash)**.
* Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Experience in **regulated environments (e.g., HIPAA, SOC 2)** is a plus.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Promotion to permanent employee
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* Are you amenable for a Night Shift schedule (9pm - 6am PHST)?
* Do you have your own equipment at home?

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Duties and responsibilities

* CI/CD and Release Management
* Design, implement and maintain Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for build, test and deployment.
* Manage version control, branching and release processes across environments.
* Integrate DevOps toolchains, including Git, build systems and release management tools.
* Cloud and Infrastructure Management
* Provision and manage infrastructure using Terraform, ARM templates and other IaC practices.
* Manage Azure subscriptions, resource groups, access control and cost optimisation.
* Optimise platform performance, reliability and operational efficiency.
* Containerisation and Platform Operations
* Support containerised application delivery using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Manage container registries and platform services used by development and testing teams.
* Monitoring, Security and Compliance
* Implement monitoring, logging and alerting using Prometheus, Grafana or equivalent tools.
* Apply DevOps security best practice and support compliance requirements.
* Collaboration and Incident Management
* Work closely with development, operations, QA and delivery teams to enable seamless software delivery.
* Support troubleshooting and incident management in Dev/Test environments and drive fixes.
* Automation and Continuous Improvement
* Automate operational tasks using Python, PowerShell or shell scripting.
* Maintain awareness of emerging DevOps technologies and best practice.
* Skills Base:
* Strong knowledge of CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps, GitHub or equivalent tools.
* Strong knowledge of Azure cloud services and cloud resource management.
* Good knowledge of Infrastructure-as-Code practices, including Terraform and ARM templates.
* Good knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes and container registries.
* Good knowledge of monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.
* Strong scripting capability in Python, PowerShell or shell.
* Understanding of .NET and Node.js application delivery environments.
* Knowledge of DevOps security, access control and compliance practices.

Qualifications/Experience

* Minimum 5 to 7 years of DevOps, Platform Engineering or equivalent software delivery experience.
* Hands-on experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and release processes.
* Experience managing and deploying Azure cloud resources.
* Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code and container orchestration technologies.
* Demonstrated collaboration and communication skills across development, operations and delivery teams.
* Desirable: experience with GitHub Copilot or similar AI-assisted coding platforms.
* Desirable: experience working across multi-cloud environments such as Azure and AWS.

Pay: Up to Php140,000.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Makati

new_jobs.title: Cloud DevOps Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Position Overview:**

As a Cloud DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the infrastructure and operational workflows that enable the efficient deployment and management of applications and services in cloud environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the reliability, scalability, and security of cloud-based systems, while leveraging automation and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines. Your expertise in cloud platforms, infrastructure-as-code (IaC), and DevOps principles will be critical in driving efficient and effective cloud operations.

**Responsibilities:**

Cloud Infrastructure Design and Deployment:

* Design, implement, and maintain scalable and reliable cloud-based infrastructure architectures (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) using infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools.
* Configure and optimize cloud services such as virtual machines, containers, load balancers, and auto-scaling groups to meet application requirements.
* Collaborate with development teams to establish deployment pipelines and enable continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices.

Automation and Configuration Management:

* Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools to streamline deployment, provisioning, and monitoring processes.
* Utilize configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, Puppet, Chef) to ensure consistency and manage infrastructure configuration changes.
* Implement infrastructure monitoring and logging solutions to enable proactive identification and resolution of operational issues.

System and Application Monitoring:

* Set up and maintain monitoring systems to track infrastructure and application performance metrics, ensuring high availability and reliability.
* Respond to system alerts and troubleshoot performance bottlenecks, working closely with relevant teams to resolve issues promptly.
* Implement incident response processes and participate in on-call rotations to provide timely support and minimize service disruptions.

Security and Compliance:

* Implement and enforce security best practices, including access control, data encryption, and vulnerability management, in accordance with industry standards and regulations.

Collaboration and Documentation:

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including developers, system administrators, and network engineers, to optimize cloud infrastructure and application performance.
* Document infrastructure configurations, deployment processes, and troubleshooting guides to ensure knowledge sharing and maintain a comprehensive repository of operational procedures.
* Stay up to date with emerging cloud technologies, industry trends, and best practices, and evaluate their potential impact on the organization's infrastructure and operations.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field or 4+ years of professional experience
* 3+ years of hands-on development experience in an object-oriented programming language or similar.
* Strong experience with cloud platforms such as AWS **(must have)**, Azure, or Google Cloud, including infrastructure provisioning, networking, and security.
* Hands-on experience with containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration frameworks like Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with scripting and programming languages (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell) for automation and tool development.
* Understanding of DevOps principles and experience implementing GitLab CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in cloud-based environments.
* Knowledge of security best practices and experience implementing security controls in cloud infrastructure.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Knowledge of configuration management tools like Ansible, Puppet, or Chef is a plus.
* Relevant certifications, such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer or Azure DevOps Engineer, are a plus.
